outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Cliffhawk Warden tactical sprite sheet using attached identity reference. Athletic adult woman with brown windblown braid, blue scarf and mustard sash, blue-white feather shoulder mantle, brown leather armor and knee guards, blue split tabard, rope coil at belt, TWO-HANDED wooden hooked steel pike, small brown hawk perched on shoulder. Same face, body size and elevated three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. Exactly twelve independently articulated complete poses FOUR columns THREE rows, generous gutters so every pike tip and bird wing stays inside its cell. Row1: idle pike diagonal both hands; alert breathing feather mantle and hawk head turn slightly; walking contact right near leg steps forward; opposite contact right near thigh extends BACK left across forward far thigh, not mirrored torso. Row2: passing step one knee under hip; attack anticipation pike drawn back right elbow behind waist, hawk wings partly open for balance; strong two-handed forward pike thrust RIGHT front knee bent, rear hand still on shaft near hip, hawk gripping shoulder; defensive bent-knee brace both hands spread along pike shaft held across chest. Row3: impact recoil head and shoulders back; dying knees buckling pike slipping down hawk lifting off shoulder; side fall woman torso low bird now absent; final dead woman lying on SIDE horizontal torso/head eyes closed pike resting alongside, hawk absent, no blood. True elbow/hip/knee articulation, no duplicate standing figures or rotated standing corpse. Preserve original grounded painterly design, no magical projectiles or extra weapons. Plain pale gray background no floor, shadows, checkerboard, text, panels or scenery.
